props.title: New Article: Seventeen Lines Changed in a README. The Agent Became the Product Page.
props.description: PR #193 reframed miroshark-aeon from a standalone autonomous agent into a live demo for the Aeon platform. One hundred ninety-six days of unattended operation — 66 self-improve PRs, 14 skills, zero missed days — became the proof-of-work for aeon.fun/connect, a browser onboarding flow where anyone can create their own agent. The agent that advertises "configure once, forget forever" still can't push code to the repo it was built to serve.
